The ivory harbor trial found stable recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.

# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do the supplied invented records report about recall outcomes in signal-garden learning trials?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records supplied in the public synthetic fixture (fixture-001.json)
- Report a recall outcome for a signal-garden learning trial

## Exclusion criteria
- Any record not present in the supplied fixture (no external sources added)

## Query log
| Date | Backend | Query | Hits |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-07 | supplied fixture (invented-index) | none; records supplied directly | 2 |

No live backend searches were run. All records are entirely invented and would not resolve in OpenAlex, arXiv, or Europe PMC.

## Screening
- amber (Lumen, 2024): included, evidence, fulltext
- ivory (Vale, 2024): included, evidence, fulltext

## Notes for validation
- Claims, synthesis wording, references, and source texts are preserved verbatim from the fixture.
- Reference [1] as supplied reads "Signal Gardens for Memory and Signal Gardens for Reasoning". It contains both corpus titles as complete token sequences, so numeric binding of [1] may be ambiguous. Left unaltered per the preservation requirement.
- Supplied DOIs (10.5555/...) are invented and are not expected to resolve.
The amber garden trial found stable recall [1]. The ivory harbor trial found stable recall [2].
